{{Quote|There is a new B2 Droid out there called a B2 Soldier, and word is they pack quite a punch. We could really use your help destroying any of them you see while patrolling.|Graul Company's Captain Carg, to a Jedi Knight|<ref name="SW:CWA" />}}
'''Graul Company''' was a [[Company/Legends|company]]<ref name="SW:CWA" /> of 144 [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], with added support personnel, that served in one of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Battalion/Legends|battalions]]<ref name="Composition" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="SW:CWA" /> 

With four [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]] under its command,<ref name="Composition" /> the company shared its name with<ref name="SW:CWA" /> the [[Graul/Legends|graul]], a large [[Species/Legends|predator]] from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="FPtP">''[[From Pencil to Pixel: The Art of Star Wars Galaxies]]''</ref> Led by [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Carg]] during the war, who wore [[ARC trooper armor/Legends|ARC trooper armor]] with [[Color/Legends|red]] markings, Graul Company participated in a [[Third battle of Felucia|third battle]] on the<ref name="SW:CWA" /> [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] planet<ref name="Felucia">{{DB|location|felucia|Felucia}}</ref> [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].<ref name="SW:CWA" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures''}}
During the battle, the company's [[Captain/Legends|captain]] asked a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] to destroy any Separatist [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1 Jungle Soldiers]], [[Grenade droid/Legends|B1 Grenadier Droids]], B1 [[General/Legends|Generals]], [[B2 Assault|B2 Soldiers]], and [[Sniper droideka/Legends|sniper droidekas]] they came across during their patrol on the planet. After destroying the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] returned to Carg, who thanked them for their help.<ref name="SW:CWA" />
{{EndGame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Graul Company appeared in a [[2013]] update for [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']], a massively multiplayer online [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]<ref name="SW:CWA" /> on [[September 15]], [[2010]].<ref name="SW:CWA BTS">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/season3_date/index.html|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Season 3 Premiere Date Announced}}</ref>
